blocks.content: Explore a dashboard to see which of its panels measure the machine's resources, the USE method, and which measure the service as its users experience it, the RED method.
Both measure a machine's resources, so they belong to the USE method. Both show how much of the resource is in use: utilization. USE measurements report on the causes of issues.
Focus on the **client side full page load** panel.

Both measure the service as its users experience it, so they belong to the RED method. Requests over time is the rate. Page load time is the duration. Because RED reports symptoms rather than causes, it's the method to alert on.

RED has a third measurement, errors. There is no panel that counts failing requests, so this dashboard can't tell you whether requests are failing.

The four golden signals name the same three service measurements as RED, as traffic, errors, and latency, and add saturation: how close a resource is to its capacity. No panel here shows that either.

The remaining panels, **logins**, **Google hits**, **Support calls**, and **Sign ups**, are business measurements. Neither method covers them.
Focus on the **Latency P50 / P95 / P99** panel.

These three panels measure the service as its users experience it. Request Rate is the rate, Error Ratio is the errors, and Latency is the duration, so together they cover the RED method.

No panel here shows saturation: how close a resource is to its capacity.
